notes.title: AI Update
notes.notes:
- ADJUSTED: Several changes have been made to improve the ai's understanding of space, when to freeze, its ability to locate the player and a mechanism for each AI to seek out a random player every 60 seconds
- ADJUSTED: The player sense frustum has been adjusted to a more limited viewing angle that closely matches the player camera
- ADJUSTED: The scroll to switch equipment is now able to switch equipment even when melee weapon is out
- FIXED:  Bug where there was no walk animation while holding a melee weapon
- FIXED: Bug where the pyramid level sfx wasn't looping
- FIXED: Bug where some decals from various gates were showing in the wrong level

notes.title: Quality of Life Update:
notes.notes:
- ADDED: DLSS support
- ADDED: Whips Slain Stat & xp per kill
- ADDED: Logic to ensure Figures are chasing at least every 30 seconds
- ADJUSTED: Overall xp required per level
- ADJUSTED: The lowest and highest time to determine time xp values (more time added)
- FIXED: Wrong Valuable Item Icon showing on Sewer map

notes.title: Massive Update!
notes.notes:
- In game objectives have been added
- The E key is now for Interact and right click will drop a glowstick
- You can pick up valuable items by interacting and drop them with B (controller also supported)
- To access the scanner/scrap of paper - look down and toggle equipment with scroll wheel
- There is now a Trophy Section, with trophies obtained by completing in game objectives
- Many minor bugs have been resolved

notes.title: Companion Update!
notes.notes: New companions have been added for single player & some minor bug fixes have occurred.

notes.title: March 2024 Update:
notes.notes:
ADDED: New Whip monster
ADDED: Melee weapons

notes.title: Quick update for FPS resetting issue
notes.notes: Small fix for an issue where the FPS setting is reset to use the maximum available GPU power - it now defaults to a 60fps limit.

notes.title: November Patch: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- RESOLVED: Pyramid Stats not saving
- RESOLVED: Glowstick Spinning
- RESOLVED: Glowstick being kicked away by character
- RESOLVED: See through Pyramid Columns

notes.title: November Update: New Content + Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- ADDED: New map (Pyramid)
- ADDED: New How-to guide
- ADJUSTED: Glowstick mechanic updated
- ADJUSTED: Stats UI Updated

- RESOLVED: Eye Material bug

notes.title: Glowstick Adjustments & Bug Fix
notes.notes:
- RESOLVED: Spamming the 'Drop Glowstick' button would cause it to remain in your hand instead of compass
- RESOLVED: Glowsticks causing a drop in performance
- ADJUSTED: Can now only have a maximum of 3 glowsticks at one time
- ADJUSTED: Glowsticks will glow for 30 seconds
- ADDED: New Glowstick UI appears at bottom left of HUD when 'Drop Glowstick' button pressed, disappears after 5 seconds (retriggerable delay)

notes.title: New content + bug fixes!
notes.notes:
New content:
- Flashlight variants
- New Sewer water (now simulated + foam)

Bug fixes:
- Sewer custom maze light bug fixed

notes.title: Bug fix + Damage indicator
notes.notes:
Bug fix:
- RESOLVED: Getting caught in a spawn trap after dying at a checkpoint. There will now be a 5 second grace period after respawn that you cannot be caught. I have also added a screen damage effect that will mark this timeframe (so the moment you are caught it will begin and the moment it stops you can now be caught again)
